headline: February calls with some support: Three Saturday in Shukla Paksh (S&P and Sensex); Mercury in Paap Kartari (B116) (Sensex). When the table's rules are chosen on 2000–2013 only, 2 of 22 rule-and-index tests held after 2013 (Three Saturday in Shukla Paksh on both indices); about 1.1 would by chance, so that is the best-supported table rule, not a proven one. Mercury in Paap Kartari is a source rule; its record for this window's case (no benefic aspect) is bearish on the Sensex, but it is a 2000–2026 record, not a walk-forward test. Out of sample the table labels as a whole and the combined model score what chance gives; treat the rest as leanings.
